evaluations.title: Attention Is All You Need
evaluations.reference: We propose the Transformer, a novel neural network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions to achieve superior translation quality and faster training.
evaluations.generated: the dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. the best performing models connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. we propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer.

evaluations.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
evaluations.reference: BERT introduces deep bidirectional transformer pre-training from unlabeled text, enabling state-of-the-art fine-tuning across diverse natural language processing tasks.
evaluations.generated: a new language representation model called BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text. the pre-trained model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models.
